The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. The `codeanalyzer` module compiles, but I didn't run any tests and added none.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. An unmatched contributor is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true.

A blank latest-commit date already counts as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for blank dates. Configured teams are unchanged.

The check reads the contributor's merged latest-commit date. I only skimmed the merge code, so I haven't confirmed it picks the most recent date across repositories.
